description:
Configure three new 'service' items in NCH Copper Point of Sale. These items must not track inventory quantities. 

Create the following items:
1. Name: 'Virus Removal', Code: 'VR01', Price: $89.00
2. Name: 'System Tune-up', Code: 'ST01', Price: $49.99
3. Name: 'Data Transfer', Code: 'DT01', Price: $60.00

For each item, ensure that Stock Management/Inventory Tracking is DISABLED (so the system does not count quantity on hand). Navigate to Items, add the new items, configure the details and stock settings, and save.
